title: Real stationary distributions are uniform
statement: Let $G$ be a finite nonempty $D$-regular multigraph with $D>0$, and suppose it is connected and nonbipartite. Let $p$ be a real-valued function on its vertices whose values sum to $1$. For each pair of vertices $u,v$, let $P(u,v)$ be the probability that a uniformly chosen indexed neighbor of $u$ is $v$. Then the condition $\sum_u p(u)P(u,v)=p(v)$ for every vertex $v$ holds if and only if $p(v)=1/|V(G)|$ for every vertex $v$.
